theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_ll_approx_grad_unique
theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (u u' : Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt N A x Q → u ∈ Q → u' ∈ Q → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μHE[N] (A ∩ ball x r ∩ {y | ε * ‖y - x‖ < |h y - h x - inner ℝ u (y - x)|}) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ N)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μHE[N] (A ∩ ball x r ∩ {y | ε * ‖y - x‖ < |h y - h x - inner ℝ u' (y - x)|}) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ N)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → u = u'
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
